reference.question:
What is the lateral surface area of a cone with base radius 3 and slant height 5? (The area can be written in the form \(k\pi\); enter only the value of \(k\).)

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_258_q1_question_en.svg)
reference.solution:
Method 1: Cone lateral-area formula

\(S_{\text{lateral}}=\pi rl=\pi\times 3\times 5=15\pi\), so \(k=15\).
